headline: Zoetis (NYSE:ZTS) Misses Q2 CY2026 Sales Expectations
summary: Animal health company Zoetis (NYSE:ZTS) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales flat year on year at $2.47 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $9.22 billion at the midpoint came in 5.4% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.87 per share was 1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
